name: Agriculture Or Husbandry
overview: Scripture reveals that agriculture or husbandry is a God-ordained responsibility given to man from the beginning, as seen in Genesis 2:15 where God placed Adam in the garden to cultivate and keep it. Following the Fall, this task became burdened with toil and hardship, as the ground was cursed to produce thorns and thistles, requiring sweat and labor for sustenance (Genesis 3:17-19, 23). The distinction between Cain as a tiller of the ground and Abel as a keeper of sheep (Genesis 4:2) highlights the foundational roles of agriculture and animal husbandry in human provision and stewardship.
